results.content:
There’s plenty of work ahead as I prep for the retreat, but passion always takes the lead. This island fuels me, grounds me, and reminds me why I do what I do.  
Grateful that I’ve found @villa\_las\_perseidas to host my retreats. Friendly hosts who accommodate me and my guests.  
2 back to back retreats all full booked 🙏  
  
#sandydonnelly #dbchealthretreat #pilatesretreat #healthretreat #lanzarote [...] Back on the island to prepare for my Pilates & Hiking Retreat in Lanzarote.  
  
There’s a particular kind of magic I feel every time I land here — not just because the sun greets me without fail, but because this island has held my wellbeing retreats for nearly two decades.  
18 years of returning, several times a year, and that familiar feeling still washes over me the moment I arrive. It’s like stepping back into a place that knows me as well as I know it.
